verdict.rationale: Reflect's own API uses OAuth 2 with PKCE, and users create their own client credentials. The published OpenAPI spec defines separate read:graph and write:graph scopes, so a user can grant an agent read-only or write access. The scoping is coarse, though: just two graph-wide scopes, with no documented finer-grained limits or credential lifecycle controls. Missing for 10: fine-grained per-resource or per-graph scopes, documented token revocation/expiry and per-agent credential management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
